task.title: Show the task change history in the web UI
task.description:
Surface the task change history in the web board's detail view. WB-01KZ1JCYZCPD156TCXMRB4Z6ZB ships the operations projection, the per-operation-pack entry model, and the Go word-level description diff; this task adds only the HTTP surface and the rendering. Add a task history route and a TaskHistoryReader to the handler's per-capability constructor, matching how TaskLister, TaskCreator, and the rest are already wired in internal/webui/handler.go. Unlike the CLI, where history is opt in behind --history, the detail view shows it by default.

Render status as a lifecycle lane rather than another flat row type. Status is the most common change by a wide margin, 103 of the 166 field.set operations in this project's history, and a lane reading ready to in-progress to in-review to done communicates a task's life in a way a chronological list cannot. Keep other field changes as ordinary rows beside it, one row per operation pack, and drill down from a row into a comparison view. Decide whether that comparison is its own route, an inline expansion of the existing detail form, or a modal.

Reuse the diff spans the server already computes for the CLI. Add no JavaScript dependency, no build step, and no external asset: internal/webui/assets/index.html is a single self-contained file of Go templates and vanilla JavaScript that references no external script, stylesheet, or font, it is served from a loopback address, and it must keep working offline. Node is an optional test dependency today and must not become a build dependency.

Out of scope: any change to the operations projection, the entry model, or the diff algorithm, all of which belong to WB-01KZ1JCYZCPD156TCXMRB4Z6ZB; undo or discard affordances; and a comparison range syntax.
